## Purpose

Describe the problem and the focused change made to address it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and documented any tests I could not run.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, evidence, databases, logs, private keys,
      model caches, or local account configuration.
- [ ] I documented new network access, subprocess execution, authentication,
      storage, or model downloads.
- [ ] My commits include a `Signed-off-by` line and I accept the contribution
      terms in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
